close_reason: FALSE ALARM: matches_rfc822_name handles .domain syntax correctly (tests 21,23 pass)
description: matches_rfc822_name: when constraint starts with '.' (e.g. '.testcertificates.gov'), the apex exclusion check (lines 997-998) compares domain.eq_ignore_ascii_case(suffix) where suffix is 'testcertificates.gov'. If domain == 'testcertificates.gov' this returns false (correct apex exclusion). But PKITS 4.13.21 uses constraint '.testcertificates.gov' and subject 'Testing@testcertificates.gov'. The domain part is 'testcertificates.gov', apex check fires, returns false — subject is REJECTED. But PKITS says it must VALIDATE. This means the apex exclusion logic for RFC822 .domain constraints is wrong: RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 says '.domain' matches any address AT that domain (apex included, unlike DNS). The apex exclusion in matches_rfc822_name is incorrect for the email case; it should only apply to DNS-style subdomain-only semantics. Three PKITS tests (21, 23, 25) are ignored because of this.
title: RFC 822 domain suffix (.domain) constraint not matched — false permit
